mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as firms can meet demand more efficiently.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $420,000,000, indicating strong retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days, driven by increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > 420,000,000, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by < 0.5% in a month, signaling controlled inflation during easing, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days due to reduced inflation fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 7%, indicating an improving labor market, boosts investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when UNRATE < 7%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating growing housing market activity, signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of HOUST growth (t-test p > 0.05).
